design.name: 夫诸
design.brief: The Fuzhu (夫诸) of the Shan Hai Jing, 'shaped like a white deer with four horns', whose appearance brings floods, turned into an ice ranged attacker: an elegant white deer with four tall branching horns made of clear glacier ice that glow aqua-cyan at the tips, a frost-white coat with pale teal markings, long slender legs with cloven hooves, a short tail; a glowing aqua-cyan gem on its chest (weak spot). It fires beams of frost from its horns. Graceful and aloof.
design.weapon: lowering its four glowing ice horns to fire a beam
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the desert roster (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and hands or paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges, ice as a few big faceted shapes, scales and fins as big simple carved shapes. Real deer anatomy under the stylization.
